description.en: We are a trusted food trading company specializing in sourcing, importing, exporting, and distributing premium-quality food products worldwide. With a commitment to quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction, we supply fresh, frozen, and packaged foods to supermarkets, restaurants, hotels, retailers, and businesses through efficient global logistics and competitive wholesale solutions.
description.ar: نحن شركة تجارة أغذية موثوقة متخصصة في توفير واستيراد وتصدير وتوزيع المنتجات الغذائية عالية الجودة في جميع أنحاء العالم. مع التزامنا بالجودة والموثوقية ورضا العملاء، نقوم بتوريد الأغذية الطازجة والمجمدة والمعبأة للسوبر ماركت والمطاعم والفنادق وتجار التجزئة والشركات من خلال خدمات لوجستية عالمية فعالة وحلول جملة تنافسية.

aboutPage.companyBannerSubtitle: شريكك في تنفيذ المشاريع ، حلول شاملة لتوافق تطلعاتك
whoWeAreParagraphs: تأسست شركة نسيم الأعمال في ١١ ديسمبر ٢٠١٦، ومقرها الرئيسي في مكة المكرمة. تتخصص الشركة في تنفيذ المشاريع، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الحلول والخدمات طوال الفترة المختلفة.
لدينا خبرة واسعة في تنفيذ المشاريع السنوية والموسمية. تشمل خدماتنا الشاملة للتجهيز والتوريد والتوزيع والتنفيذ الميداني، الشركات العامة والشركات تدعم المشاريع وقطاعات الحج والعمرة والضيافة.

نسعى لبناء شراكات مبتكرة من خلال تقديم حلول مرنة ومبتكرة - ترتكز على الجودة والكفاءة والالتزام - لتلبية متطلباتهم الخاصة وإنشاء قيمة مضافة لأعمالهم. بصفتنا شركة رائدة في تصدير واستيراد المواد الغذائية، نفخر بالعمل مع الفنادق وشركات التموين ومصانع الأغذية ومتاجر التجزئة والموزعين والجهات الحكومية في مختلف أنحاء العالم. وقد بنينا سمعتنا على الجودة والنزاهة والشفافية والشراكات التي تدوم طويلاً.
aboutPage.visionText: أن نكون الخيار الأول لتنفيذ المشاريع وتوفير الحلول والخدمات المتكاملة في مختلف القطاعات.
aboutPage.missionText: تنفيذ وإدارة المشاريع، وتقديم حلول وخدمات متكاملة عبر مختلف القطاعات - بكفاءة وجودة وابتكار - لضمان رضا العملاء، وتطوير قدرات الموظفين، وخلق قيمة مستدامة.
aboutPage.valuesIntro: نؤمن بأن استدامة الأعمال ونجاحها يرتكزان على مجموعة من القيم التي توجه أعمالنا وقراراتنا وعلاقاتنا مع عملائنا وشركائنا.
aboutPage.objectivesIntro: We strive for leadership and excellence in our operations through the following objectives:
objectivesList: 1. Project execution and management: Carried out with efficiency and professionalism, in accordance with standards of quality and excellence.
2. Achieving client satisfaction: By providing integrated solutions and services that meet client needs and exceed their expectations.
3. Expanding the scope of our business and services: Entering new markets and sectors to foster growth and broaden our reach.
4. Building sustainable strategic partnerships: Based on trust, credibility, and mutual interests.
5. Developing innovative solutions and services: Designed to keep pace with market changes and address the evolving needs of our clients.
6. Enhancing operational efficiency and productivity: Through performance optimization and the best possible use of resources.
7. Attracting and developing human talent: While fostering a work environment that encourages creativity and excellence.
8. Ensuring profitability and financial sustainability: To strengthen the company’s continuity and its capacity for growth and competitiveness.

privacyPolicy.intro: Welcome to Al Naseem Al Atta. We value your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal information you share with us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, disclose, and protect your information when you visit our website or use our services. By accessing our website, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We may collect personal and business information when you interact with our website or contact our team. The information we collect may include your name, company name, email address, phone number, country, business address, shipping information, billing information, and any details you provide through contact forms, quotation requests, or customer support inquiries.

We may also collect technical information automatically, including your IP address, browser type, operating system, device information, pages visited, referring website, visit duration, and browsing behavior. This information helps us improve website performance, security, and user experience.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: The information we collect is used to provide and improve our services, respond to inquiries, prepare quotations, process orders, manage customer accounts, arrange deliveries, communicate important updates, provide customer support, and improve our website.
We never sell your personal information to third parties.
bullets: Respond to product and pricing requests.

sections.heading: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
paragraphs: Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to improve functionality and provide a better browsing experience. Cookies help us remember user preferences, analyze website traffic, improve navigation, and enhance security.

sections.heading: Information Sharing
paragraphs: We only share information when necessary to provide our services or comply with legal obligations, including shipping companies, freight forwarders, customs brokers, payment processors, logistics partners, and government authorities when legally required.

sections.heading: Data Security
paragraphs: Protecting customer information is a top priority. We implement appropriate technical, administrative, and organizational security measures designed to protect personal information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.

sections.heading: Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, your personal information, or our privacy practices, please contact us.

termsAndConditions.intro: Welcome to Al Naseem Al Atta. These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern your access to and use of our website, products, and services. By visiting our website, requesting quotations, placing orders, or engaging in business with us, you agree to comply with these Terms.

sections.heading: Acceptance of Terms
paragraphs: By accessing this website, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms and Conditions. These Terms apply to all visitors, customers, suppliers, distributors, business partners, and users of our website and services.

sections.heading: About Our Company
paragraphs: Naseem Al-Ataa Trading Company is a professional food trading company specializing in the sourcing, import, export, wholesale distribution, and supply of premium-quality food products. We serve supermarkets, restaurants, hotels, catering companies, food manufacturers, retail stores, government institutions, healthcare facilities, wholesalers, and distributors in domestic and international markets.

sections.heading: Products and Services
paragraphs: We offer a wide range of food products, including but not limited to:
bullets: Beverages, Canned Foods, Dry Fruits & Nuts, Organic Products

sections.heading: Quotations, Orders & Pricing
paragraphs: All quotations provided by our company are subject to product availability, market prices, shipping costs, currency exchange rates, and supplier confirmation. Orders are considered confirmed only after written acceptance by our company and, where applicable, receipt of the agreed payment or deposit.

sections.heading: Shipping and Delivery
paragraphs: We work with trusted logistics providers to deliver products efficiently and securely. Delivery schedules are estimated based on supplier production, shipping routes, customs clearance, and transportation conditions.
